Prose depth is written in the Strategies for Enhancement in Food Production fill pass. ## 2.…  ·  **Sustainable agriculture** meets today's food needs without destroying the resource base — soil, water and biodiversity. **Biofertilizers** are its nutrient corner-stone: living microbes that fix nitrogen, solubilise phosphorus or decompose organic matter, replacing part of the chemical fertiliser load.…

rows.label: Shortcut
rows.text: Trick 1: Biofertilizer bank: Rhizobium (legume nodules), Azotobacter/Azospirillum (free-living), blue-green algae Anabaena/Nostoc (rice fields), mycorrhiza (Glomus — P uptake, drought resistance) — four classes with roles.  ·  Trick 2: Organic farming triad: organic manures/compost, biofertilizers, IPM (biocontrol) instead of chemicals — the sustainable package.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: **Worked example — the rice paddy that fertilises itself.** A farmer floods his paddy and lets *Azolla* fern cover the water surface. Inside every Azolla leaf lives *Anabaena*, a cyanobacterium that fixes atmospheric nitrogen.…  ·  ## 7. Exam Zone NEB past-question map (long/short), topic-wise MCQs with explanations, and short tricks (block VII). Existing entrance-exam (CEE) material stays where it is; this zone grows around it — see the seeded exam fields of this file when present.  ·  **Most-asked points (NEB).** (1) Define sustainable agriculture and biofertilizer. (2) Name four biofertilizers and what each contributes. (3) Explain the Azolla-Anabaena rice system. (4) What is IPM and why does it beat calendar spraying? (5) List three problems caused by fertiliser overuse that sustainability fixes.

rows.label: More ideas
rows.text: ## 8. Summary and self-check 5–10 line chapter summary, self-check questions and the common-confusions list (block VIII) — completed in the unit fill pass.  ·  **Summary.** Sustainable agriculture closes nutrient loops: biofertilizers supply N and P biologically, compost returns organic matter, rotation and IPM cut chemical dependence. **Self-check:** can you match each biofertilizer to its crop system (legume nodules, rice paddy, orchard mycorrhiza)?
